objectives: 這門經濟學是一學年的課程, 這個課程提供學生關於經濟學的基本概念. 這學期我們將關注在個體經濟的部分, 內容包括:需求, 供給, 消費者行為, 市場, 國際貿易, 廠商行為與產業組織. 這門課程將提供一些基本的分析工具, 用他們來解釋一些個體經濟現象.
content:
Week 01: Introduction, Ten Principles of Economics, Thinking Like an Economist
Week 02: Supply and Demand
Week 03: Elasticity and Its Application
Week 04: Holiday
Week 05: Supply, Demand and Government Policies
Week 06: Consumer, Producers, and the Efficiency of Markets
Week 07: The Costs of Taxation
Week 08: Holiday
Week 09: Midterm Examination
Week 10: Gains from Trade, International Trade
Week 11: Externalities, Public Goods and Common Resources
Week 12: The Costs of Production
Week 13: Firms in Competitive Markets
Week 14: Monopoly, Monopolistic Competition
Week 15: The Markets for the Factors of Production
Week 16: Final Examination
books: Mankiw, N.G., (2027). Principles of Economics, 11th edition, Asia Edition, Cengage Learning.
grading_policy: 期中考 35％, 期末考 35％, 作業 20%, 出席 10％
